notes: Phase 1.5 literature check ran (strict, cutoff 2025-09-24) with 6 logged queries via related_search.py; the 12-query budget was not exhausted. A search returning 5 results kept none and one returned nothing, so the C3 (positional-embedding) claim had weak search coverage. Ambiguities in the skill: (1) the Phase 0 fingerprint script leaves most fields empty and must be hand-edited; (2) the instructions say per-claim novelty should be rated from retrieved abstracts, but the search tool returns only partial abstracts, and I could not retrieve VideoRoPE's abstract, so that novelty rating was left 'pending' instead of inventing a level; (3) 'pool position' bands (typical rejected 42-54) and the 'Overall 4 requires pool >= 65' rule interact so that a lenient Perspective reviewer at pool 66 must give 4, which then needs a down-weight to land the EIC rating near 3; (4) the DA CRITICAL criteria are written mostly around leakage, so a paper whose main claim is untested rather than contradicted yields no CRITICAL issue by design; (5) the unweighted-vs-weighted Avg check relied on benchmark subset sizes not present in the paper (flagged Medium confidence, reviewer knowledge, validated on two baseline rows). The paper has no code-release statement; figures were not available, so Fig. 3 and Fig. 4 were judged from text only. Reviewer passes shared one model context (disclosed).
